title: Salesforce (CRM) Stock May Be 49% Undervalued On Its $1.6B VA Deal
title_zh: Salesforce (CRM) 股票因其 1.6B 美元 VA 交易可能被低估 49%
summary: Salesforce stock has rebounded in recent weeks after a challenging start to the year, and valuation tools now suggest the market price may sit well below an intrinsic value estimate based on a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model.
summary_zh: 在经历了今年充满挑战的开局后，Salesforce 股票最近几周出现反弹，估值工具现在表明，市场价格可能远低于基于贴现现金流 (DCF) 模型的内在价值估计。

title: Integer Holdings stock surges 21% on KKR takeover report
title_zh: KKR 收购报告影响 Integer Holdings 股价飙升 21%
summary: Investing.com -- Integer Holdings (NYSE:ITGR) shares surged 21% Friday afternoon following a Wall Street Journal report that private-equity firm KKR is near a deal to take the medical-device outsourcing company private.
summary_zh: Investing.com——周五下午，《华尔街日报》报道私募股权公司 KKR 即将达成将医疗设备外包公司私有化的交易后，Integer Holdings (NYSE:ITGR) 股价飙升 21%。

title: KKR Near Deal to Buy Integer Holdings
title_zh: KKR 即将达成收购 Integer Holdings 的交易
summary: Private-equity firm  KKR  is near a deal to take medical-device outsourcing company  Integer Holdings  private, according to people familiar with the matter.
summary_zh: 据知情人士透露，私募股权公司 KKR 即将达成协议，将医疗设备外包公司 Integer Holdings 私有化。
